name: motion-reel
description: 影视级分镜场景编排与回放工具
interaction: A cinematic storyboard orchestrator where users drag-and-drop scene nodes onto a timeline canvas, arranging camera angles, transitions, and timing with fluid, film-strip-style gestures. Playback renders the sequence in real-time with viewport scrubbing, allowing directors to preview, tweak, and re-render scenes interactively—cutting between shots as naturally as editing film on a steenbeck.
